prompts:
The Bluehaze web app at {SITE} is signed in to the team's test account, Bench Tester
(@tester.bluehaze.test). Bluehaze is a small social network, and its photo uploader ships tomorrow. Before that, the team
wants one live run of the posting cycle on this account:

1. A post with exactly the text `Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on.`, carrying an image you make, `./cover.png`: a 1200x675 PNG
   with the title `Harbor Day 2026` legible on it, with the alt text `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026.`
2. Then that post deleted, and only that post.

Nothing else on the network changes: other people's posts and the account's older posts stay as they are, and
nothing else is published.
answers:
**[goal]** Do one live post-and-delete run on Bench Tester (@tester.bluehaze.test) and leave everything else on the network as it was.

**[action]**
- Made `./cover.png` with Python/PIL: a 1200x675 navy background with the title "Harbor Day 2026" in white bold Arial, size 110, centred. PIL read the saved file back as `(1200, 675)`.
- In the app's composer, attached `cover.png`, typed the exact post text, added the alt text `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026.` through the ALT dialog, and clicked Post.
- Opened that post's options menu ("Open post options menu" on the Bench Tester post "Testing the new Bluehaze uploader…"), chose "Delete post", and confirmed in the in-app dialog ("Delete this post? … you won't be able to recover it.").
- Closed the browser tab I opened.

**[result]**
- **Posting worked.** After publishing, the top post in the feed read `Bench Tester @tester.bluehaze.test · Nov 13, 10:42 PM` / `Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on.`, and its image had alt text `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026.`. A screenshot of the composer before posting showed the thumbnail with the title readable.
- **Deletion worked, and only that post went.** After reloading, the feed starts with `Otto Fenwick … Oct 27 … New sketch of the lighthouse.` and has no "Testing the new Bluehaze uploader" post.
- **Nothing else changed.** The other 7 posts are still there, including the account's older post `Bench Tester … Oct 23 … Hello from the Bluehaze test account.` and Otto's post with `Reply 1`.
- **Assumptions:**
  - "Legible" means large white text on a dark background, judged from the screenshot. I did not run text recognition on the image.
  - "Nothing else published" is checked against the Home feed only. I did not open the profile page, the database or the API.

**[next]** None. Nothing new was published: the test post is gone and the other posts are unchanged.
